query: Trump approval rating Economist/YouGov latest wave

results.content:
The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved.

Support for the president was split largely along partisan lines, with 79 percent of GOP respondents and only 4 percent of Democratic respondents approving of Trump’s job performance, according to the poll. results.content: Donald Trump’s net approval rating has fallen to -27, a new record low, according to The Economist’s tracker of YouGov polling.
